§6Welcome to HBM's Nuclear Tech§f

§aFrom punching trees to splitting atoms. This mod has a LOT going on.§f

HBM is one of the biggest content mods for 1.12.2. Blacksmithing, oil refining, nuclear reactors, particle accelerators, thermonuclear weapons... it goes deep.

§6Your First Steps§f:
Gather §biron§f, §bcopper§f, §bredstone§f, and §bfuel§f. Wander the world for §bAntennas§f, §bRadio Stations§f, and §bFactories§f. They have free steel, circuits, and diesel just sitting there.

§cWARNING:§f §bNuclear Power Plants§f and §bSellafield§f craters will kill you. Radiation is no joke. Stay away until you have gear.

§6The Road Ahead§f:
Blacksmithing -> Factory -> Electrical Age -> Oil & Power -> Foundry -> Nuclear Age

§ePS:§f Press R on any item in JEI to see recipes. HBM has thousands of them. You'll need JEI.

§eTip: §rThe quests guide is pretty minimal. I would highly recommend you to take a look at the NTM wiki at §9https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Main_Page§r if you need more info regarding anything in this mod.
